name: Niizuma Fuwa Toro Iyarashi Este Mainichi ga H na Lucky × Trouble × Happening
original_name: 新妻ふわトロ癒やらしエステ　毎日がＨなラッキー×トラブル×ハプニング
source: The protagonist is in training massage therapist nearly graduated but is despised by his boss stopping him from moving up the ladder from becoming full time employee. Because of this he gets very little experience to practice. Until one day with a luck a woman with influence approaches him and asks for a message. This starts a chain reaction that the protagonist massage technique is something very special doing more than just a massage for his clients. Yet strangely has opposite effect on men.
translation: 主角正在接受按摩治疗师培训，即将毕业，但遭到老板的鄙视，阻止他晋升为全职员工。正因为如此，他的练习经验很少。直到有一天，幸运的是，一位有影响力的女人走近他，询问他的消息。这引发了连锁反应，即主角的按摩技术非常特别，不仅仅是为他的客户提供按摩。但奇怪的是，对男性却有相反的影响。
